english.title: Trader fail to obtain consumer signature in relation to withdrawal provisions
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, failed, before entering into a regulated contract, to obtain the signature of the consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY CONSUMER..), to each section of the contract dealing with your obligations under regulation 16(1) of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(2) and (4) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
